item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:50 HKT 22/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coastal areas of Guangdong on Wednesday morning. The weather will become appreciably cooler with showers and thunderstorms over the region. It will be windy with occasional showers in the following couple of days. Another cold front is expected to reach the coast of southern China during the weekend, and will bring unsettled weather again.

Date/Month: 22/03 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 4, becoming south force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy and foggy with a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms later, showers will become more frequent.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 23/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4, force 5 offshore.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers. Showers will be heavy at times at first with thunderstorms. Becoming appreciably cooler.
Temp range: 17 - 24 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 24/03 (Thursday)
